items: The page uses a warm pale cream background in the hero and footer, with vivid blue links and accents.
The header is a compact horizontal navigation bar.
The hero uses a two-column layout: large blue heading and description on the left, photograph on the right.
The contact section has a thin horizontal divider, the section title on the left, and a vertically stacked form on the right.
The form uses mostly full-width outlined controls and a black Submit button.
The footer contains the OpenAI brand at left, navigation columns across the upper area, and social/legal links below a thin blue divider.

At the bottom of the reference image, a decorative series of horizontal blue lines transitions into a solid blue area. Reproduce this only if it is part of the supplied reference design; do not interpret it as text or content.
Use the separately supplied PNG for exact colors, spacing, typography, imagery, and responsive visual comparison. These notes are descriptive, not pixel measurements.

• The page uses a warm pale cream background in the hero and footer, with vivid blue links and accents.

  • The contact section has a thin horizontal divider, the section title on the left, and a vertically stacked form on the right.
  • The form uses mostly full-width outlined controls and a black Submit button.
  • The footer contains the OpenAI brand at left, navigation columns across the upper area, and social/legal links below a thin blue divider.
  • At the bottom of the reference image, a decorative series of horizontal blue lines transitions into a solid blue area. Reproduce this only if it is part of the supplied reference design; do not interpret it as text or content.
